title: Add per-provider cost tracking
description: Hand-curated pricing table per model (input/output per 1M tokens). Hook into Mastra generation lifecycle to log {agent, model, provider, in_tokens, out_tokens, in_cost, out_cost, total_cost} per call. Always-on log line; OTEL metric gated on OTEL_ENABLED. Pricing table lives alongside capabilities registry.

title: Add Anthropic prompt caching via capability registry
description: Add 'prompt-caching' capability to MODEL_CAPABILITIES. Agents opt in via a per-agent flag; when the configured model supports caching, wrap system prompt in providerOptions.anthropic.cacheControl: { type: 'ephemeral' }. Scope: system prompt only for v1 (tool schemas deferred). Fail-closed on non-Anthropic models (providerOptions simply not attached).

title: Add per-agent model params (temperature, maxTokens, topP)
description: Extend providers/models.ts with per-agent parameter overrides driven by env (EXECUTION_TEMPERATURE, EXECUTION_MAX_TOKENS, etc.). Individual env vars per param, not JSON blob. Thread through to agent construction. Foundation for prompt-caching and cost-tracking work.

title: Provider infrastructure: params, caching, cost tracking, test hygiene
description: Epic covering four follow-ups to foreman-as9's per-agent provider config: AIMock fixture refresh, per-agent model params (temperature, maxTokens), Anthropic prompt caching via providerOptions, and per-provider cost tracking. All on branch claude/add-multiple-providers-wXhQJ.

title: Add flexible per-agent model provider config
description:
Extract hardcoded MODELS constant into src/lib/providers/ module so each agent's model is driven from env. Introduces MODEL_DEFAULT/FAST/HEAVY tier defaults and per-agent overrides (FOREMAN_MODEL, DISCOVERY_MODEL, EXECUTION_MODEL, SUPERVISOR_MODEL, HISTORY_MODEL). Per-agent vars accept comma-separated fallback chains mapped to Mastra's ModelWithRetries[] shape.

Capability registry (providers/capabilities.ts) tracks tools + streaming across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google models. validateAgentCapabilities() runs at Mastra boot and fails fast on unknown models, typos, or missing capabilities.

All existing behavior preserved when no env vars set. 200 tests pass, 11 new tests in providers.test.ts. Implemented on branch claude/add-multiple-providers-wXhQJ, commit f017d55.
close_reason: Provider flexibility delivered: central providers module with per-agent env overrides (FOREMAN_MODEL, DISCOVERY_MODEL, EXECUTION_MODEL, SUPERVISOR_MODEL, HISTORY_MODEL) + tier defaults (MODEL_DEFAULT/FAST/HEAVY), comma-separated fallback chains mapped to Mastra ModelWithRetries[], capability registry (tools + streaming across Anthropic/OpenAI/Google), startup validation that fails fast on unknown models. 15 new unit + integration tests pass (11 provider resolution/validation + 4 AIMock routing). 204 tests total, zero regressions. Commits f017d55, ced8818 on branch claude/add-multiple-providers-wXhQJ.

title: Re-enable OpenAI end-to-end test after AIMock annotations drift fix
description: AIMock v1.14.3's OpenAI Responses API emitter omits the annotations: [] field on output_text content parts, which @ai-sdk/openai's Zod schema now requires. AIMock classifies this as warning-level drift (not critical) so their auto-fix pipeline has not shipped a fix yet. There is no documented hook (fixture override, config flag, or middleware) inside AIMock to patch the response shape. The docs-documented fix points — wrapLanguageModel, createOpenAI({fetch}), HTTP proxy — all require patching application or test code, which is a workaround we do not want.\n\nAction items: (1) File a drift report upstream at https://github.com/CopilotKit/aimock/issues naming the annotations field and citing the drift-detection policy. (2) Track the upstream fix or the AIMock version that reclassifies this as critical. (3) When the field is emitted, re-add the openai/gpt-4o smoke test in tests/integration/provider-swap.test.ts that was removed in commit ac63ee8.

title: Refresh AIMock fixtures for current @ai-sdk schemas
description: Fixtures in tests/fixtures/aimock/ drifted from OpenAI Responses API (needs annotations: []) and Anthropic /v1 path handling. Non-blocking but noisy in integration tests. Fix fixture JSON + aimock-setup.ts base URL handling, re-run provider-swap integration test to confirm clean deserialization.
